coverage_decision: All main-text figures and tables and all supplied supplement tables/figures were inspected and reconciled. Bibliography pages were extracted to Markdown but not atomized.
omissions_and_reasons: Pure bibliography entries were excluded from LiteratureAtom extraction by protocol.
No external sources were used to repair source-internal discrepancies.

source_consistency_flags.main_source: Main Methods, PDF p.15: all-cause hospitalization, time to first hospitalization, irrespective of prior hospitalization history.
source_consistency_flags.supplement: Supplementary Table S1, p.1: "Diabetes-related hospitalisation (HOS)" = admission with primary diagnosis E11.x–E14.x.
source_consistency_flags.resolution: Not repaired. Both source statements are preserved; the exact implemented claims outcome cannot be established unambiguously from the supplied materials.

source_consistency_flags.main_source: Table 2 presents adjusted HRs under EMPA vs DAPA / EMPA vs DPP4i and the prose interprets HR <1 as lower risk with EMPA.
source_consistency_flags.figure: Figure 2 legend labels the same plotted values "DAPA vs EMPA" and "DPP4i vs EMPA".
source_consistency_flags.resolution: Not repaired. SEA treats Table 2/prose as the effect-direction interpretation and flags the figure legend as internally inconsistent.

source_consistency_flags.methods: Methods, PDF pp.13–14: exposure/new-user classification on or after January 1, 2016.
source_consistency_flags.figure: Figure 1, PDF p.30: antidiabetic drug exposure "since 2016.05".
source_consistency_flags.resolution: Not repaired. Both dates are reported as printed.

source_consistency_flags.main_source: Main Methods, PDF p.15 includes new-onset acute/chronic kidney disease, progression to advanced CKD, or initiation of dialysis.
source_consistency_flags.supplement: Supplementary Table S1, p.1 defines kidney event as incident acute kidney injury or advanced CKD and supplies N17.x/N18.x/N19 codes; no dialysis procedure code is shown.
source_consistency_flags.resolution: Not repaired. The supplement appears narrower/less explicit than the main-text definition.
